notes.title: Devlog #24 Game, Set, Love...?
notes.content:
You didn't expect that, huh?

Like we've said - our game is not only about football stadiums. 
We have something for everything!

Today we want to introduce to you our blessed by King Richard himself - tennis area!

If you are a fan of Open Era, know what a Bagel is and are perfectly aware why a Fault has happened, you will be really pleased by what we prepared for you.
Again, you won’t be bored with stuff we have prepared for you this time!

But this week we have some photos from the beginnings of your mission!

First thing first - let's see what do we deal with, alright?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33646252/1e7ce607107a45ef186741b533fa628778166c04.png[/img]

Oh, damn - why is it so dark in here? Let's go find some electricity to lighten up this place, shall we?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33646252/240d3a58ec316ba656d4b3661d345693b1af2dcf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33646252/24b30435b45b7bd17a7b7e1a8820c7c17e11bdb6.png[/img]

Need to go to through the lockers! Okay, but what's with the benches again?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33646252/1ac5097800add2993f3b8519b7830e1f6edd3b93.png[/img]

Almost the... oops! Wrong room! Also - damn, this needs some plastering - look at this raw wall!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33646252/a2b79bbbf8c70388ce8f05f4510d0cd597197678.png[/img]

There we go! Let's put some light on this place!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33646252/1715e824bb9323af7f53395dc036103a2d2c6c61.png[/img]

Okay whoa! We got some work to do here!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33646252/17a62801280c18cef6f2ebdddc01cb296ca00b98.png[/img]

Some different angles before we begin!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33646252/65a8d917389159923b5d93fc09b0b4df8c38d482.png[/img]

So now we got this out of the system and ready for some plastering, and refurbishing - stay tuned for next parts!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/948880/Stadium_Renovator/

notes.title: Dev Log - 10
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hello Stadium Builder![/b][/h2]

Today we have great news for you! Recently, our team has been working on a new environment and refining the lighting you see in the game!
We wanted to introduce more natural-looking lighting that would make you feel more real to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33646252/53be010a4f76dd02ff8ccdaddfccd42b32356837.png[/img]

For our game, we chose a more refined model of buildings and a new environment that is pleasing to the eye. We have added, among others, tenement houses that are located around the stadium area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33646252/ab081bc5c7525d4768e2d7e21ef025d6aa840b14.png[/img]

The lighting we have added to Stadium Renovator is lighting created in Unity HDRP - static and dynamic. Thanks to this, we finally created a more realistic and pleasant atmosphere.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33646252/52f84728862167c779f35219a123038151d68890.png[/img]

Let us know how you like the presentation of new products and what do you think about the new lighting! We are very curious about your opinion!
We wish you a nice weekend!
